verses.greek: Ἀποθέμενοι οὖν πᾶσαν κακίαν καὶ πάντα δόλον καὶ ὑποκρίσεις καὶ φθόνους καὶ πάσας καταλαλιάς,
verses.literal: Having put aside therefore all malice and all deceit and hypocrisies and envies and all evil speakings
verses.dgt: Therefore, putting away all malice and all deceit and hypocrisies and envies and all slanders,

verses.greek: ὡς ἀρτιγέννητα βρέφη τὸ λογικὸν ἄδολον γάλα ἐπιποθήσατε, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ αὐξηθῆτε εἰς σωτηρίαν,
verses.literal: like newborn babies the reasonable pure milk do crave so that by it you may grow up in respect to salvation
verses.dgt: like newborn infants, long for the pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow into salvation,

verses.greek: εἰ ἐγεύσασθε ὅτι χρηστὸς ὁ κύριος.
verses.literal: if you have tasted that is good the Lord.
verses.dgt: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is good.

verses.greek: Πρὸς ὃν προσερχόμενοι, λίθον ζῶντα, ὑπὸ ἀνθρώπων μὲν ἀποδεδοκιμασμένον παρὰ δὲ θεῷ ἐκλεκτὸν ἔντιμον
verses.literal: To whom coming a stone living by men indeed rejected in the sight of however God chosen and precious
verses.dgt: Coming to him, a living stone rejected by people but chosen and precious before God,

verses.greek: καὶ αὐτοὶ ὡς λίθοι ζῶντες οἰκοδομεῖσθε οἶκος πνευματικὸς εἰς ἱεράτευμα ἅγιον, ἀνενέγκαι πνευματικὰς θυσίας εὐπροσδέκτους θεῷ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·
verses.literal: also you yourselves as stones living are being built up as a house spiritual into a priesthood holy to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.dgt: you yourselves also, as living stones, are being built into a spiritual house for a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

verses.greek: διότι περιέχει ἐν γραφῇ· Ἰδοὺ τίθημι ἐν Σιὼν λίθον ἀκρογωνιαῖον ἐκλεκτὸν ἔντιμον, καὶ ὁ πιστεύων ἐπʼ αὐτῷ οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ.
verses.literal: Therefore it is contained in Scripture: Behold I lay in Zion a stone cornerstone a chosen precious and the one who is believing on Him certainly not may be put to shame.
verses.dgt: For it stands in Scripture: “Look, I lay in Zion a chosen and precious cornerstone, and the one who believes in him will certainly not be put to shame.”

verses.greek: ὑμῖν οὖν ἡ τιμὴ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν· ἀπιστοῦσιν δὲ λίθος ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας
verses.literal: To you therefore is the preciousness of those believing for those disbelieving however the stone which rejected those building this has become into the head of the corner
verses.dgt: Therefore the honor is for you who believe, but for those who disbelieve, “the stone that the builders rejected—this one became the head of the corner,”

verses.greek: καὶ λίθος προσκόμματος καὶ πέτρα σκανδάλου· οἳ προσκόπτουσιν τῷ λόγῳ ἀπειθοῦντες· εἰς ὃ καὶ ἐτέθησαν.
verses.literal: and A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense They stumble at on the word being disobedient to which also they were appointed
verses.dgt: and “a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word, to which they also were appointed.

verses.greek: Ὑμεῖς δὲ γένος ἐκλεκτόν, βασίλειον ἱεράτευμα, ἔθνος ἅγιον, λαὸς εἰς περιποίησιν, ὅπως τὰς ἀρετὰς ἐξαγγείλητε τοῦ ἐκ σκότους ὑμᾶς καλέσαντος εἰς τὸ θαυμαστὸν αὐτοῦ φῶς·
verses.literal: You yourselves however are a race chosen a royal priesthood a nation holy a people for His possession so that the excellencies you may proclaim of the One out of darkness you having called to the marvelous of Him light
verses.dgt: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s possession, so that you may proclaim the excellencies of the one who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

verses.greek: οἵ ποτε οὐ λαὸς νῦν δὲ λαὸς θεοῦ, οἱ οὐκ ἠλεημένοι νῦν δὲ ἐλεηθέντες.
verses.literal: who once were not a people now however the people of God those who not received mercy now however having received mercy.
verses.dgt: Once you were not a people, but now you are God’s people; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

verses.greek: Ἀγαπητοί, παρακαλῶ ὡς παροίκους καὶ παρεπιδήμους ἀπέχεσθαι τῶν σαρκικῶν ἐπιθυμιῶν, αἵτινες στρατεύονται κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς·
verses.literal: Beloved I exhort you as aliens and sojourners to abstain the from fleshly desires which war against the soul
verses.dgt: Beloved, I urge you as foreigners and sojourners to abstain from fleshly desires, which wage war against the soul.

verses.greek: τὴν ἀναστροφὴν ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἔχοντες καλήν, ἵνα, ἐν ᾧ καταλαλοῦσιν ὑμῶν ὡς κακοποιῶν, ἐκ τῶν καλῶν ἔργων ἐποπτεύοντες δοξάσωσι τὸν θεὸν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπισκοπῆς.
verses.literal: the conduct of you among the Gentiles keeping honorable so that wherein which they speak against you as evildoers through the good deeds having witnessed they may glorify the God in the day of visitation.
verses.dgt: Keep your conduct among the Gentiles honorable, so that in the matter in which they speak against you as evildoers, by observing your good works they may glorify God on the day of visitation.

verses.greek: Ὑποτάγητε πάσῃ ἀνθρωπίνῃ κτίσει διὰ τὸν κύριον· εἴτε βασιλεῖ ὡς ὑπερέχοντι,
verses.literal: do be subjected to every human institution for the sake of the Lord whether to the king as being supreme
verses.dgt: Submit to every human institution for the Lord’s sake, whether to a king as supreme,

verses.greek: εἴτε ἡγεμόσιν ὡς διʼ αὐτοῦ πεμπομένοις εἰς ἐκδίκησιν κακοποιῶν ἔπαινον δὲ ἀγαθοποιῶν
verses.literal: or to governors as through him being sent for vengeance to evildoers praise however to well-doers
verses.dgt: or to governors as sent by him for punishment of evildoers and praise of those who do good.

verses.greek: (ὅτι οὕτως ἐστὶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ, ἀγαθοποιοῦντας φιμοῦν τὴν τῶν ἀφρόνων ἀνθρώπων ἀγνωσίαν)·
verses.literal: because this is the will the of God doing good to put to silence the the of foolish men ignorance
verses.dgt: For this is the will of God: by doing good to silence the ignorance of foolish people,

verses.greek: ὡς ἐλεύθεροι, καὶ μὴ ὡς ἐπικάλυμμα ἔχοντες τῆς κακίας τὴν ἐλευθερίαν, ἀλλʼ ὡς θεοῦ δοῦλοι.
verses.literal: as free and not as a cover-up having the for evil the freedom but as of God servants.
verses.dgt: as free people, yet not using freedom as a covering for evil, but as servants of God.

verses.greek: πάντας τιμήσατε, τὴν ἀδελφότητα ἀγαπᾶτε, τὸν θεὸν φοβεῖσθε, τὸν βασιλέα τιμᾶτε.
verses.literal: Everyone do honor The brotherhood do love the God do fear the king do honor.
verses.dgt: Honor everyone. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

verses.greek: Οἱ οἰκέται ὑποτασσόμενοι ἐν παντὶ φόβῳ τοῖς δεσπόταις, οὐ μόνον τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς καὶ ἐπιεικέσιν ἀλλὰ καὶ τοῖς σκολιοῖς.
verses.literal: you who are Servants be subject with all fear the to masters not only to the good and gentle but also to the unreasonable.
verses.dgt: Household servants, be subject to your masters with all fear, not only to the good and gentle but also to the crooked.

verses.greek: τοῦτο γὰρ χάρις εἰ διὰ συνείδησιν θεοῦ ὑποφέρει τις λύπας πάσχων ἀδίκως·
verses.literal: This for is acceptable if for sake of conscience toward God endures anyone griefs suffering unjustly.
verses.dgt: For this is gracious if, because of consciousness of God, someone endures sorrows while suffering unjustly.

verses.greek: ποῖον γὰρ κλέος εἰ ἁμαρτάνοντες καὶ κολαφιζόμενοι ὑπομενεῖτε; ἀλλʼ εἰ ἀγαθοποιοῦντες καὶ πάσχοντες ὑπομενεῖτε, τοῦτο χάρις παρὰ θεῷ.
verses.literal: What kind of for credit is it if sinning and being struck you will endure? But if doing good and suffering you will endure this is commendable before God.
verses.dgt: For what credit is there if, when you sin and are beaten, you endure it? But if when doing good and suffering you endure, this is gracious before God.

verses.greek: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ ἐκλήθητε, ὅτι καὶ Χριστὸς ἔπαθεν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, ὑμῖν ὑπολιμπάνων ὑπογραμμὸν ἵνα ἐπακολουθήσητε τοῖς ἴχνεσιν αὐτοῦ·
verses.literal: To this hereunto for you have been called because also Christ suffered for for you you leaving an example that you may follow after the steps of Him:
verses.dgt: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example so that you might follow in his footsteps.

verses.greek: ὃς ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ ἐποίησεν οὐδὲ εὑρέθη δόλος ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ·
verses.literal: Who sin not committed neither was found trickery in the mouth of Him
verses.dgt: “He committed no sin, nor was deceit found in his mouth.”

verses.greek: ὃς λοιδορούμενος οὐκ ἀντελοιδόρει, πάσχων οὐκ ἠπείλει, παρεδίδου δὲ τῷ κρίνοντι δικαίως·
verses.literal: Who being reviled not was not reviling back suffering not was threatening He was delivering Himself however to the One judging justly
verses.dgt: When insulted, he did not insult in return; when suffering, he did not threaten, but entrusted himself to the one who judges justly.

verses.greek: ὃς τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν αὐτὸς ἀνήνεγκεν ἐν τῷ σώματι αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ ξύλον, ἵνα ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ἀπογενόμενοι τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ ζήσωμεν· οὗ τῷ μώλωπι ἰάθητε.
verses.literal: Who the sins of us Himself bore in the body of Him on the tree so that the to sins having been dead the to righteousness we may live Of whom by the wounds you have been healed.
verses.dgt: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that having died to sins we might live to righteousness. By his wound you were healed.

verses.greek: ἦτε γὰρ ὡς πρόβατα πλανώμενοι, ἀλλὰ ἐπεστράφητε νῦν ἐπὶ τὸν ποιμένα καὶ ἐπίσκοπον τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν.
verses.literal: You were for like sheep going astray but you have returned now to the Shepherd and Overseer of the souls of you.
verses.dgt: For you were like sheep going astray, but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
